verdict.rationale: Dialpad hosts its own API reference on developers.dialpad.com, with per-endpoint pages such as /reference/webhookslist, and its developer portal describes itself as the home of its docs, guides and API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, runnable code examples within the reference, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Gets a list of all the webhooks that are associated with the company.
